event_data.summary: When an automated build check fails for a reason unrelated to the submitted change, a retry may fail again. Tiber now permits a separate repair in that situation, but the action guidance shown to assistants still describes retries as the only choice. Explain the supported repair option so operators can recover without unnecessary retries or changing the original diagnosis.
event_data.title: Explain when failed build retries permit a separate repair
